ops.title: CORRECTION: the captain-hook role collapse widens nothing — v0.20's business route never checked roles
ops.body:
Corrects cc-notes b371954, written 2026-08-02 by me before the enforcement code was read. Its
central claim was false and it is a security record, so this supersedes it.

b371954 said: "Any peer admitted to the Business lane may invoke anything on that lane, where
previously its role bounded it," and framed the seven-to-three collapse as a deliberate widening.

**The role never bounded it.** Verified directly in the module cache at
daemonkit@v0.20.10/wire/session.go:716-731:

    case routeBusiness, routeObservation, routeLifecycle:
            ...
            if entry.route == routeLifecycle {
                    if err := s.server.authorizeLifecycleControl(frame.Op, s.role); err != nil {

Role authorization fires ONLY for routeLifecycle. routeBusiness carried no role check, so every
admitted role could already invoke every registered product op. There was no per-role authority on
the business lane to lose.

What the migration actually did, per the captain-hook reviewer audit of all seven roles:

- business, lifecycle, stopControl (identity capt-hookd): unchanged. Stop/drain stays host-only.
- helperConsumer, helperBrokerLifecycle, helperBrokerHandoff (identity: helper app): **NARROWED** --
  each previously reached receipts and readiness (AllowsReceipt/AllowsReadiness,
  wire/runtime_bind.go:396-398) and now reaches product ops only. Handoff was withdrawn
  substrate-wide.
- helperClient (identity: bridge): unchanged -- it could already invoke every product op including
  captain.restart-workers.v1, because of the missing business-route check above.

Three roles narrowed, four unchanged, none widened. The one widening-shaped fact -- the bridge
reaching restart-workers -- is a v0.20 property predating the cut.

The collapse is a net STRENGTHENING: ServingSigned(hostRequirement()) closes a real v0.20 hole
where a client trusted whatever process accepted on the socket (the old client config carried only
Dial, WireBuild, Role, MaxFrame and verified nothing about the server).

Pinned by TestHostTrustFoldsSevenPeerClassesOntoThreeLanes.

Process note: I recorded a security consequence from the shape of an API without reading what it
enforced, and the reviewer caught it. A decision note asserting a security cost needs the same
evidence bar as the code.
